killedBy: the campaign board unlock (issue #983) pairs a board with its level through the level's arenaId -- not the board's id, and not arena numbering
the campaign board unlock (issue #983) unlocking a board offers it at exactly the counts and modes its entry declares
the campaign board unlock (issue #983) drops a retained board the save has not unlocked, and blames the lock rather than an axis
why: Keys the unlock on the catalog entry's id instead of the arena it plays. Every shipped campaign entry has id === arenaId, so the whole shipped offer reads identically; the first entry whose id differs from its campaign arena would slip past the lock. Issue #983 requires the pairing to come from each campaign level's `arenaId`, not from board ids, which only a synthetic entry can tell apart. Proved before its tests existed: SURVIVES at 0 of 20 in scope on the gate's own commit, then KILLED by 3 of 29, measured.
